property_summary: For any actor who deposits some Ether and later calls Collect, the total Ether successfully transferred out by Collect and its reentrant callbacks cannot exceed the actor's original deposit (and thus address(c).balance cannot fall below MinSum), because P's nonReentrant_ guard blocks any reentrant Collect while the first Collect is still executing; M removes that guard so a reentrant callback can drain extra Ether and make address(c).balance drop below MinSum.
change_summary: Delete the require(!locked_) check at the start of nonReentrant_, allowing reentrant calls to proceed.
